dict.string: Earshot records the meeting app’s own audio (the other participants) via a Core Audio process tap.
Earshot needs microphone access to record meeting audio for transcription.
Earshot needs Screen Recording permission to detect active meetings by reading window titles.
Earshot names meetings after your calendar events, suggests their attendees as speakers, and asks to record when an in-person meeting starts.
Earshot adds the tasks from your meeting notes to Reminders when you ask it to.
Earshot uses Accessibility to detect mute state and read meeting participants.
